summary: A 1934 steel lookout in the Bradshaw Range of the Prescott NF, NHLR-registered 2003. Two sources agree on 1934; coordinates conflict and staffing is unverified.

facts.design: 40-foot Pacific Coast Steel tower with a modified L-4 live-in cab

visit.trail_note: A trail guide describes the Horsethief Basin road as a remote route that off-roaders drive.

events.note: NHLR says constructed in 1934; trail guide says erected in 1934 at the end of the CCC-built road

evidence.supports: located in the Bradshaw Range on a mountain in the Prescott National Forest; constructed in 1934
evidence.quote: Located in the Bradshaw Range on a mountain in the Prescott National Forest, Horsethief Lookout was constructed in 1934.

evidence.supports: 40-foot Pacific Coast Steel tower with a modified L-4 live-in cab; in active service
evidence.quote: It is a 40’ Pacific Coast Steel tower with a modified L-4 live-in cab and is active service

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR point (34.162250, -112.220170) sits about 6.7 km east of the FFLA point (34.16244, -112.29272), a great-circle distance computed from the two coordinates. The record's OSM point (34.162531, -112.270441) falls between them. Coordinates are not corrected here; the story notes the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates disagree three ways: NHLR 34.162250, -112.220170; FFLA 34.16244, -112.29272; record (OSM) 34.162531, -112.270441. Not corrected; a surveyed point would settle it. The trail guide invites readers to scale the tower ('you'll even be invited to scale the Horsethief Lookout'); that is not verified, and the story does not encourage climbing. No 2026 staffing or closure source was found. The Horsethief Cabin (a separate 1939 building) appeared only in a search snippet and is not used. Verification pass (2026-10-08) corrected the source name in the story and replaced the vague distance with the computed figure.
